$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v1005-strip-integer2-lowerleft.xml (Rule 10, D-030). A real production strip map. Covers: BinType=Integer2, four fixed-width hex characters concatenated; NullBin=FFFF marking two whole off-strip rows; MapType ABSENT again; a two-level layout where the CHILD carries LowerLeft 4.5,42 - a parent-relative offset that is the only non-zero one in the corpus - plus a Z element with Order, Height and its OWN Units (um) differing from the layout's DefaultUnits (mm); Orientation 180; and BinDefinitions carrying all five attributes at once, including BinQuality and Pick=false. TopLevel is written "True" with a capital T in the XML, which xs:boolean does not accept and the parser tolerates - the JSON is a real boolean, because there is no legacy JSON to be tolerant of.
